name: lineup-engine
description: A deterministic, explainable NBA lineup builder.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,engine,api,web -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "pnpm --filter @lineup-engine/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @lineup-engine/basketball-engine dev" "pnpm --filter @lineup-engine/api dev" "pnpm --filter @lineup-engine/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @lineup-engine/api build && pnpm --filter @lineup-engine/web build
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build
